race.comment: Race decimated by scratchings. Of those remaining, ADASITI (4) is on top. Was just over a year between runs when a tough fourth over 1400m at Narrandera. Fitter now and will benefit with Cole's 2kg claim. Sure to run well. APPLE CIDER (9) finished third, only beaten 0.8 lengths, last start over 1300m at Wangaratta. Likes the conditions and won't get a better chance to feature. PERFECTLY GOOD (10) reasonable effort last start when 6 lengths away in third over 1600m at Wagga. Back in trip and look for a big run. IMA GURU (11) finished second, beaten 2.75 lengths, last start over 1300m at Wodonga. In the mix.
